column1: The Qing Empire and the Opium War|1995|10|10|1842|9,8,7.5,8,8,9,7,9,7.5,8|Mao Haijian|Archival explanation of military capability, information failures, diplomacy and decisions in the first Opium War. https://assets.cambridge.org/97811070/69879/frontmatter/9781107069879_frontmatter.pdf establishes original Chinese 1995 and English translation 2016; H4 passes, publication age uses original. Stephen Platt's review extract https://academic.oup.com/ahr/article-abstract/123/5/1650/5221110 corroborates the departure from nationalist orthodoxy. D=8 low confidence from introduction, contents and review extract: different campaigns and institutional constraints add learning; detailed chronology may be lower-yield. Chinese decision focus T11 and war T12; endpoint 1842. Historical analysis, not a military training manual.

Red Capitalism|2011|10|10|2011|8,8.5,8,8.5,8,7.5,8,8.5,7.5,7.5|Carl E. Walter and Fraser J. T. Howie|Insider explanation of Chinese banking, bond markets, state-directed credit and implicit guarantees. https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/book/10.1002/9781119199083 identifies both authors and 2011 original copyright before the 2012 revision; https://search.worldcat.org/title/1036839628 confirms 2011 publication. Risks described are conditional vulnerabilities, not proof of an inevitable collapse on a specified date. D=8 low-confidence description estimate: balance-sheet and institutional links offer distinct mechanisms; some period-specific market detail has aged. T11 national economy and T12 finance; approximate endpoint 2011. Explanatory narrative rather than technical valuation training.

The Wobbling Pivot, China since 1800|2010|10|10||8.5,8,7.5,8,7.5,9,6.5,9,7.5,8|Pamela Kyle Crossley|Interpretive history organized around tensions between central control and local initiative. https://www.wiley-vch.de/en/areas-interest/humanities-social-sciences/the-wobbling-pivot-china-since-1800-978-1-4051-6080-3 verifies 2010 and purpose. Suitable for students does not make this explanatory narrative a technical curriculum. D=7.5 low confidence from contents/description: recurring center-local comparisons can add changing constraints, not automatically padding. T11 national history, T12 politics; broad cross-period account H13=0. Centralization is an organizing lens, not established as a sufficient explanation of all Chinese events.

China's Crony Capitalism|2016|10|10|2015|7.5,8,7.5,8,7.5,8,7,9,7.5,7.5|Minxin Pei|Analysis of how partial property-right reform, patronage and collusion enable corruption. https://www.jstor.org/stable/j.ctv24trdg8 confirms 2016 and publisher thesis; publisher description at https://www.harvard.com/book/9780674737297 identifies evidence from over 200 corruption cases. Selected prosecuted cases cannot by themselves measure the prevalence of corruption or prove imminent regime failure; E reduced for inferential reach. D=7.5 low-confidence description estimate: distinct collusive transactions add mechanisms, repeated corruption cases may have uneven yield. Both national focus and politics deductions; approximate evidence endpoint 2015. Critical conclusions alone are not V2 or partisan recruitment.

Factions and Finance in China|2007|10|10|2006|8.5,8.5,8,8.5,8,8.5,7.5,9,7,8|Victor C. Shih|Research monograph explaining how elite factional incentives shape credit, inflation and bank policy. https://www.cambridge.org/core/books/factions-and-finance-in-china/C03A806642C88C39EDB9FB83CF2189BA lists release 3 December 2007; front matter https://assets.cambridge.org/97805218/72577/frontmatter/9780521872577_frontmatter.pdf says first published/copyright 2008. Use publisher release year 2007, moderate confidence with discrepancy retained. Main purpose is causal institutional explanation rather than a technical economics curriculum. D=8 low-confidence contents/description estimate: political and financial evidence add complementary constraints; detailed faction mapping may be lower-yield. T11/T12; approximate study endpoint 2006, not a current forecast.

The Struggle for Taiwan|2024|0|10|2023|8.5,8,8,8,7.5,8.5,8,9,8,8|Sulmaan Wasif Khan|Historical account of triangular US-China-Taiwan relations, commitment ambiguity, escalation risk and political choices. https://www.hachettebookgroup.com/titles/sulmaan-wasif-khan/the-struggle-for-taiwan/9781541605053/ verifies 2024 and international scope. Policy lessons are interpretive, not deterministic prediction of war. D=7.5 low-confidence contents/description estimate: crises and changing commitments add comparisons, diplomatic chronology may be lower-yield. T12 geostrategic politics; international narrative and influence avoid T11. Approximate endpoint 2023; not current-event coverage beyond publication.

Out of the Gobi|2019|10|10|1986|7.5,7,6.5,6.5,6.5,8.5,5.5,8,8,7.5|Weijian Shan|Memoir of disrupted education, forced labor, practical production and later study in America. https://www.wiley.com/en-us/out-of-the-gobi-my-story-of-china-and-america-p-9781119529552 establishes 2019 and chapter structure. Institutional coercion, resource constraints and contrasting educational systems provide some transferable payload; do not treat survival as proof of a universal success formula. D=6.5 low confidence from contents/description: brickmaking and scarce-resource episodes add concrete learning, lengthy personal experiences have uneven analytical yield. Predominantly Chinese historical experience T11 and political coercion T12; approximate endpoint 1986 for early-life/educational trajectory, low confidence. Not an investment manual despite author's later finance career.

A Daughter of Han|1945|10|0|1938|7.5,5.5,4.5,4.5,6.5,8.5,2.5,7.5,8,7.5|Ning Lao T'ai-t'ai, recorded by Ida Pruitt|Oral life history of a working woman, mediated through Pruitt's transcription. https://www.huntington.org/collections/lib-655072 and https://hollisarchives.lib.harvard.edu/catalog/sch00076 verify original 1945 and nonfiction identity. Family obligations, household labor and survival constraints provide some social mechanisms despite very weak profile fit; V3 not confidently established. D=6.5 low confidence from archival descriptions and specialist review https://www.tandfonline.com/doi/pdf/10.1080/14672715.1981.10409840 : customs add historical knowledge, individual life detail has limited transfer. T11 Chinese social history, T12=0; approximate recollection endpoint 1938. One oral account is not representative measurement of all Chinese women.

God's Chinese Son|1996|10|10|1864|8.5,7.5,6.5,7,7.5,9,5.5,9,8.5,8.5|Jonathan D. Spence|Historical reconstruction of the Taiping movement, belief, organization, state crisis and military conflict. https://wwnorton.co.uk/books/9780393315561-god-s-chinese-son and https://openlibrary.org/books/OL7453376M/God%27s_Chinese_Son verify identity and original 1996. Narration of religious visions is historical attribution, not endorsement of doctrine: V5 does not apply. D=7.5 low confidence from description and review https://www.publishersweekly.com/9780393315561 : institutional and religious context adds knowledge, personalities and campaign detail reduce direct efficiency. T11 national/political-figure history and T12 war/power; endpoint 1864. Explanatory history, not fictionalized doctrine.
